channel.section_requires_connection: This section needs a connection. Try again once you are back online.

download.not_downloadable: This episode can't be downloaded for offline play
download.auto_delete_label: Auto-delete oldest when storage is full
download.auto_removed_notice: Removed the oldest downloads to free up space

search.not_available_yet: This podcast is not in our directory yet. Add it to make it available.
search.add_failed: Could not add this podcast. Please try again later.
search.add_timed_out: Still processing after several minutes. Search again shortly to open this podcast — adding does not subscribe you automatically.

groups.playback_description: Default media type and auto queue
groups.downloads_description: Storage limit, auto-free, and delete all downloads

offline_mode.title: Offline mode
offline_mode.description: Offline mode uses only downloads and other content already stored on this device. Search, Browse, sync, and anything that needs the internet stay unavailable until you turn it off.
offline_mode.unavailable: This screen isn't available in offline mode.

downloads.auto_delete_on_limit: When my download limit is reached
downloads.auto_delete_on_limit_description: Deletes the oldest finished downloads first until you are back under the limit.
downloads.auto_delete_on_device_low: When the phone is low on free space
downloads.auto_delete_on_device_low_description: Deletes the oldest finished downloads when free space drops below 1 GB, even if you are still under your download limit.
downloads.delete_all_description: Permanently deletes the local media files and download index entries on this device. This cannot be undone.
downloads.delete_all_confirm_body: This deletes every local download file and removes them from the Downloads list. Episodes will need to be downloaded again for offline play.

notifications.login_required_message: Log in to use this feature.
notifications.permission_required: Notification permission is required to enable this setting.

tab_bar.title: Tab bar
tab_bar.description: Choose which screens appear on the tab bar and in which order. Screens you hide stay in More.
tab_bar.reorder_hint: Moves this screen on the tab bar or into More

e2e.playback_intro: These controls exist only in E2E test builds. They start seeded media the product screens do not expose yet.
e2e.quick_login_popularity: Sign in as undecided E2E user

log.title: Sync log
log.intro: Problems recorded on this device while syncing or reading Home from cache. Share this with support if your podcasts, playlists, queue, or Home list stop updating.
log.clear_confirm_body: This removes every recorded entry from this device.

action_error.playback_network: The connection failed while loading this media. Check your network, then try again.
action_error.playback_unsupported: This file uses a format this device cannot play. The podcast host may need to offer a different file.
action_error.playback_file_not_found: The media file could not be found. It may have been removed from the host.
action_error.playback_decode: This device could not decode the media.
action_error.playback_audio_session: Audio could not start. Close other apps that are playing sound, then try again.
action_error.playback_invalid_source: The media address is not valid.
action_error.playback_unknown: Something went wrong while playing. Try again.
action_error.download_no_storage: There is not enough free space on this device. Free some space, then try again.
action_error.download_transfer_failed: The download did not finish. Check your connection, then try again.
action_error.download_file_missing: The downloaded file is missing from this device.
